summary: Ouster, Inc. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a secondary offering of 3,621,876 shares of common stock at $55.22 per share, with an over-allotment option of up to 543,281 shares. The offering is an ordinary shelf takedown under an existing shelf registration statement, not a special situation. Proceeds will go to the company, with Northland Capital Markets as underwriter. The filing is a routine capital raise, not an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, or other special situation. No special situation mechanics, premiums, or strategic events are present.
